subject: Coord: discovery + demo — align AE/SE/procurement/security availability

Subject: Coord: discovery + demo — align AE/SE/procurement/security availability

Hi Maya —

Great to meet you last week in the slides session. We'd love to schedule a 45–60 minute discovery + demo to align on integration points (networking, data residency) and procurement steps. Ideally we have:
- You (product champion)
- Your engineering lead (Carlos or another engineer)
- Someone from procurement (for timeline/PO questions)
- Our SE (Hiro) + myself (AE)

Proposed slots (PST):
1) Tue Dec 1 — 10:00–11:00
2) Wed Dec 2 — 09:00–10:00
3) Thu Dec 3 — 13:00–14:00

Agenda (attached): discovery goals, architecture review, security checklist, next steps. Attachment: redwood-discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page, PDF).

If none of the slots work, please share a couple of alternatives and I’ll loop in procurement.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick note on availability: Carlos is in a customer EOW freeze on Tue; Wed at 09:00 works for our timeline but procurement has a standing conflict then. Procurement suggested Thu morning (ET) but that conflicts with your afternoon options.

Carlos can join Wed 09:00 PT for the technical deep-dive if procurement can join just for the last 15–20 minutes to discuss contracting. Would that be acceptable? Procurement contact is procurement@aperture.com (they handle PO lead time and standard MSA questions).

Also looping Carlos on any pre-read he should see — he asked for our sample network diagram from you and any high-level data flow notes.

Thanks,

Maya —

I can do Wed 09:00 PT for the technical portion. A couple of things I want to cover so Carlos gets what he needs:
- High-level network diagram (I can share a standard diagram showing VPC peering, sample subnets, and optional private endpoints)
- Data residency and transient vs persisted logs (we have options for customers who want ephemeral KV cache only)
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 type II summary (we have a report) and our standard security questionnaire

I’m attaching our architecture overview for the call. Attachment: redwood-aws-architecture.pdf (3 pages, PDF).

If procurement will hop on for 15–20 minutes at the end that should be fine.

-Hiro

Hello Jasmine —

We appreciate the invite. For procurement review we typically need:
1) Standard MSA or proposed contract terms (redlines accepted)
2) PO term sheet (billing cadence, tax IDs)
3) SOC 2 report or contact for SOC 2 attestation

If you can send the MSA and PO template ahead of the call, we can review and have initial questions ready for the 20-minute procurement window. Also please include any security questionnaire — we started drafting one and attached our template. Attachment: aperture-security-questions.xlsx (Excel).
